title: Koine provider architecture
intro: Native discovery design for macOS 26+ Apple Silicon. The selected application reader uses root resource type, held-directory fixed strings/loctables and independent direct/table localization plans. Full cost certificates and family reconciliation remain open under the k215 consumption hold; mandatory whole-producer review precedes k7. Indexed long roots retain their independent provenance. All native G/N/V verdicts remain pending. Eight raw-search views are comparison. Graphs start at their dark Start here node; sequences read from their first message. Native images are components in one resident process.

diagrams.title: Root ownership → Transfer once and recheck independently
diagrams.caption: Activity view: metadata is omitted here and uses the existing reader ledger. Current/parent terminal endings share the first-root transfer contract. Failed transfer performs no metadata; ordinary refusal still reaches the second identity check.

diagrams.title: Source accounting → Preserve raw-slot and payload receipts
diagrams.caption: Pure source/root grammar, not a native capture or numeric whole-job certificate. Model examples use explicitly declared toy payloads; allocation capacities remain unresolved.

diagrams.title: Reserve cleanup before acquisition
diagrams.caption: Ownership/activity view of the selected reader operation grammar. Every invocation admits its potential disposals first; actual reads/copies and repeated raw slots charge before reuse or deduplication. Caller cancellation retains in-use resources and shared capacity until true return. Checked pure traces establish no aggregate fit, native peak or useful G/N/V outcome; saved-episode/source/wire derivation, whole-family reconciliation and k215 review remain pending.

diagrams.title: Keep unknown terms out of the sum
diagrams.caption: Evidence dependency view. All distinct saved alias episodes count; measured dimensions and conditional reader API calls cannot replace missing source, expanded root-walk, owned storage/projection or selected wire terms. Unknown costs remain null. No useful fit or native peak/G/N/V pass follows; k215 hold and whole-producer review bind.

diagrams.title: Select independent inventories and stop refused fallback
diagrams.caption: Selected semantic construction. Base-first global/direct traversal uses all four strings/loctable families; each table owns its non-reserved language inventory. Exact regional returns and observed Base/development backstops are preserved. Individual file refusal withholds affected facts; shared overflow fails the population. The pure model checks saved plans and controlled branches, not native I/O, CF matching or costs. Full certificates, whole-family reconciliation, mandatory whole-k215 review and native G/N/V remain pending.

diagrams.title: Freeze the finite metadata subject before selecting the budget
diagrams.caption: Evidence activity view. Historical macOS 26.6.2 per-item bytes, identities, direct locales and loctable keys supply 2,043 episodes; source counterparts are declared non-native. K217 selected fixed strings/loctable families, 128 KiB files, 20 MiB cumulative gross without refund and individual oversize refusal. Reader semantics then full cost derivation/reconciliation complete k215 before mandatory whole-producer review and k7. Supported-VM/source/binary/G/N/V verdicts remain pending.

diagrams.title: Admit root type and read a closed metadata plan
diagrams.caption: Selected activity view. Antony approved target-local fixed metadata reads and direct localization listing. Only root resource type uses a whole target path through 1,023 bytes; descendants use literal held-directory components. Exact file/layout and explicit preference/global/selected/Base/development selection are contracted; no opaque Bundle or unlocalized rescue. Native internal work/races/parser peaks remain unproved. L1500 has a 977 localized control and 978 old-band copy; mandatory review before k7 and G11/N8/V13 remain pending. Action handoff stays 1,024; ordinary 1,004…1,023 state stays UNKNOWN. K213/k214 refute the application file-set/useful-subject construction; k215 and mandatory review must replace it before k7. Old numerical fits are conditional counterexamples, not useful qualification.

diagrams.title: Preserve long indexed choices and the independent action refusal
diagrams.caption: Ordinary roots through 1,023 use resource type and the explicit descriptor-relative fixed-file/localization plan; larger roots use actual indexed tuples, UNKNOWN state and null flags. Directory identity does not bind stale index facts to current contents. L1500 requires 977/978 localized controls and actual boundary tuples/current identities/same-ID competitors; unchanged selected-action refusals and all native outcomes remain pending. Ordinary 1,004…1,023 metadata does not qualify action plist support. K213/k214 refute the application file-set/useful-subject construction; k215 and mandatory review must replace it before k7. Old numerical fits are conditional counterexamples, not useful qualification.

diagrams.title: Own sources and freeze publication
diagrams.caption: Component view within one resident process. The discovery image privately owns the explicit fixed-file/direct-localization reader; action and shared lookup modules acquire no contents code. Static authority, principal/action image guards, frozen publication and true-return ownership remain binding. Settings k211 deadline/lazy-reveal repairs and diagnostic saturation are preserved. Mandatory review, actual P1024/V12/L1500 and all native verdicts remain pending. K213/k214 refute the application file-set/useful-subject construction; k215 and mandatory review must replace it before k7. Old numerical fits are conditional counterexamples, not useful qualification.

diagrams.title: Choose read, prepare or reveal; consent stays in Koine’s UI
diagrams.caption: Three explicit public operations and separate human local-UI consent. RUNNING is process-only. Two ID-associated sweeps leave lazy completeness UNKNOWN and positives PARTIAL; confirmation timeout can retain uncontradicted complete-first-map choices. Lazy reveal no-such-object certifies no absence and starts no effect; V12 tests a known selection in a separate fresh unvisited incarnation. Local UI-only target-wide consent and true-return ownership bind. Reveal uses fixed-bundle openApplication; exit can relaunch. No read/prepare/reveal requests consent.

diagrams.title: Separate process readiness, response quiescence and useful cold/warm choices
diagrams.caption: Equality of full maps detects changes, not lazy health. Empty panes UNKNOWN/null; empty anchors null; positives PARTIAL/UNKNOWN. Count/call/copy overflow and incomplete-first-map timeout fail closed. Confirmation timeout retains only uncontradicted first-map positives with TIME_LIMIT/UNKNOWN and normal true-return ownership. Diagnostic saturation omits details while bounded guidance projects all reason tokens; it never loses choices or precedence. V12 still requires both complete sweeps, every exposed destination and separate unvisited-incarnation reveal; all native verdicts pending.

diagrams.title: Retain capacity until native work really returns
diagrams.caption: Freeze closes publication/admission, not a blocking native call. Four shared slots can remain occupied indefinitely; independent serviceability and native-peak limits remain finite acceptance duties. Local UI setup shares bounded native ownership but has its own 30-second UI wait, without the GraphQL cutoff; the prompt token stays held until true return.

diagrams.title: What each source can establish
diagrams.caption: Fixed Foundation, indexed/running/per-ID application and app-supplied Settings sources. Ordinary application roots use the explicit fixed-file/direct-localization exception; larger roots use actual indexed tuples without current-plist binding. Global overflow fails the population, detail saturation never loses choices. Settings process-only preparation, lazy UNKNOWN completeness and retained-first-map confirmation timeout rules remain binding. Review and all P1024/V12/L1500 native verdicts remain pending. K213/k214 refute the application file-set/useful-subject construction; k215 and mandatory review must replace it before k7. Old numerical fits are conditional counterexamples, not useful qualification.

diagrams.title: Stage every bounded application choice before publication
diagrams.caption: Complete staging remains the required behavior. Old 2,345,024-attempt/8,340,416-byte arithmetic fits only conditional dimensions refuted by the shipped baseline (L=10,794; 9,131,967 certificate subtotal at the old full envelope/128-byte locale reservation; not measured allocation). K215 and mandatory review must replace the coupled file-set/sizing/accounting design before k7. Existing owned/core gates, useful apps/helpers, diagnostic summaries and independent actions remain obligations; no gate increase or native pass is selected.

diagrams.title: Agreed source and permission boundary
diagrams.caption: Agreed requirements retained as unchanged context: app-supplied scripting, unchanged signing posture first, conditional explicit setup and background preparation. Ordinary reads remain effect-free. The native contract defines exact fields/effects; runtime usefulness/foreground/consent remains pending.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Decide child use and protected-target access
diagrams.caption: Previous raw-search permission interview. The ownership revision supersedes its raw ordering/backend questions; native reads still require prompt-free/no-hydration qualification.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Verify finite outcomes with independent controls
diagrams.caption: Previous raw-backend instruments. Retain independent serviceability and dialog/hydration controls for actual native mechanisms; prior events supply no new acceptance.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Own pipes and reap before releasing capacity
diagrams.caption: Previous find-child lifecycle proposal. No child is selected for v1 native discovery; its actual mechanisms need their own source and binary authority checks.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Keep native facts separate from source inventory
diagrams.caption: Previous root/seed inspection proposal. Native source availability, useful application discovery and finite resource ownership remain design obligations, without an invented exhaustive inventory.

diagrams.caption: Historical raw-result identity proposal. The native contract preserves per-copy application identity and action-time checks, with actual metadata/alias qualification still pending.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Delegate traversal and schedule bounded sources
diagrams.caption: Previous raw DFS/source scheduling proposal. Clients now own traversal, ordering and budgets; these mechanics are not Koine v1 requirements.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Report source completeness without invented counts
diagrams.caption: Historical raw-source coverage payload only. The current native contract now defines its own source availability/completeness and frozen nullable-item semantics; no raw count/marker supplies a native pass.

diagrams.title: Previous proposal · Choose a location and use existing actions
diagrams.caption: Previous raw-result handoff proposal. Existing launch/open/reveal contracts, authority and 1.0.1 action compatibility remain independent; native catalogue provenance awaits acceptance.

diagrams.title: Keep raw search in clients; return native starting points and catalogues
diagrams.caption: Current ownership: clients search raw files; Koine provides named native values/catalogues and separate explicit actions. API/source design exists; review and native acceptance remain pending.

diagrams.title: First-use metadata and default-handler prompt boundary
diagrams.caption: Measured macOS 26.5/25F71 on a Developer ID hardened GUI probe matching Koine’s empty entitlements and usage keys. Each case resets consent. Metadata and registered-app inspection did not prompt; file-URL handler lookup for text and alias documents did. A TextEdit URL after denial does not establish permission or safe inspection. Protected default opening remains pending a human consent/semantics decision. Removable/network volumes were unavailable. Other workspace operation acceptance remains pending.

diagrams.title: Launch or open, then capture desktop state
diagrams.caption: Existing action contract. All four mutations and their result fields require workspace:control AND desktop:control; neither read is implicit. Unconstrained selection allows running-copy reuse; a path constrains the installation. The receipt carries only optional observed PID/kernel start, for a separately authorized desktop read/focus. The three-second acknowledgment wait can end before Gatekeeper or launch completes, and the core deadline may answer first. An acknowledgment alone does not pass activation acceptance. Reveal returns Finder acknowledgment without a process. App reactions and process/file races remain acceptance limits. The v1 long-location boundary (implemented in workspace 1.0.1, with its finite VM coverage limits) resolves the target, then the application, component by component and refuses an extant location whose spelling is PATH_MAX (1,024) bytes or more, not counting its NUL, with failed before any request. Earlier short-path acceptance supplies no long-location pass.

diagrams.title: Keep dependency absence before the submission boundary
diagrams.caption: Existing action outcomes after whole-mutation preflight and live admission. Input, capability and inspection failures stay separate; no new OS consent is allocated. Dependency absence certifies only that this action submitted no domain request. After submission a timeout or failure is not a safe retry signal; late acknowledgment is ignored. Without errors at or below the result, AVAILABLE has a receipt and DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE has reason/guidance, never both. Publication errors may suppress the selected branch without changing a published status. Native acknowledgment does not prove browser content, activation or Finder selection. The v1 long-location boundary (implemented in workspace 1.0.1, with its finite VM coverage limits) resolves locations component by component and refuses an extant location whose spelling is PATH_MAX (1,024) bytes or more, not counting its NUL, with failed before any request. Earlier short-path acceptance supplies no long-location pass.

diagrams.title: Reserve identities and choose before loading
diagrams.caption: Designed startup calculation for each enabled shipped slot, deterministic for fixed verification verdicts. Approval also requires the catalogue's release signing identifier; fixtures use separate test identities. Reserved-only slots cannot load; unrelated claimants cannot evict an absent owner. A highest tie refuses that release group and repeats with remaining eligible copies, reaching the bundle if needed. Every refusal and missing bundle stays visible. Candidate-specific staging preserves quarantine provenance. Ordinary collisions and host/root failures are detailed in the spec. This view is not native verification.

diagrams.title: Keep selection frozen through publication and start
diagrams.caption: Designed lifecycle after selection. Principal conflicts between shipped selections refuse both without fallback; descriptor/schema rejection can leave images mapped but publishes no contribution and can remove authority dependents. Startup failure retains schema and capabilities. No frozen choice is retried. Core management survives provider failure; root/core startup failure can prevent listening. Acceptance uses a fresh host process per native scenario, public GraphQL, and assigned signed VM cases; all remain pending.

diagrams.title: Six providers and their authority boundaries
diagrams.caption: Proposed component composition, not separate deployment containers. Existing desktop grants expand to geometry, pointer and system media; workspace discovery/open, input and menus need distinct grants. All five new bundles use one native loader and the catalogue's release signing identities. Tool operations add any focus/input/menu authority their native effects require. The host association and interaction cleanup algorithms remain downstream design work.

diagrams.title: Capture input or menu targets without desktop control
diagrams.caption: Designed sequence for independently grantable application input or menu actions. Fresh discovery needs that provider's read grant; a previously obtained target can be used with control and a control-authorized receipt. Protected targets are refused again before effects. Bounded system Space switching is a separate operation requiring input and desktop control. References remain provider-local; this view proves no stronger native identity or menu validation.

diagrams.title: Check every effect before dispatching any action
diagrams.caption: Designed host behavior under additional-capabilities-v1. For example, workspace launch/open/reveal requires workspace:control AND desktop:control. Cleanup authority is fixed when an interaction is admitted. An unavailable dependency result certifies no effects by that action, not earlier actions. Protected/stale targets, permission refusal and ambiguous failures remain distinct. The feature needs a compatible framework minor and old/new binary acceptance.

diagrams.title: Resident application and client boundary
diagrams.caption: Runtime responsibility view: one resident Koine application contains the native UI, server and providers. Closing its management window leaves the listener and observation running. The native UI keeps management authority in process; HTTP clients present bearer credentials backed by live grants. Providers share that process and its OS permissions.

diagrams.title: Source packages and interface dependencies
diagrams.caption: Application/framework composition, shown as package dependencies rather than deployment containers. Koine supplies one shared provider framework image, Machine invokes its contracts, and separately built providers conform to them. Published Swift types and protocols carry the compatibility promise; GraphQL-library types remain private. The client owns its GraphQL adapter; no Koine-owned client helper is required.

diagrams.title: Discover windows, derive choices, focus one
diagrams.caption: Served API: query before choices and resolve an opaque reference before acting. Exact targeting is not established across actual PID reuse; see docs/specs/machine.md#native-targeting-discussion. Capability denial and missing Koine consent stay distinct; no automatic mutation replay.

diagrams.title: Authorize every action before executing any
diagrams.caption: Execution flow for an authenticated client operation. The core expands the selected GraphQL operation and checks original schema coordinates, so aliases and fragments do not rename authority. Any denied mutation action prevents all actions from beginning. Revocation is checked again at each dispatch admission. Earlier authorized effects are not rolled back if a later action fails. Enrollment and the in-process console have separately defined admission cases in the spec.

diagrams.title: Grant issuance, approval and revocation
diagrams.caption: Bearer-credential lifecycle and revocation ordering. Anonymous enrollment creates only a pending request. Existing managers or the in-process console approve requests or create manual grants. Approved grants survive restart without automatic expiry; pending-request expiry does not expire them. Secret possession permits own-request status before and after its decision; revoked grants fail authentication. Digest uniqueness prevents retries from creating multiple grants. Already admitted actions may finish. This diagram is not a model-checking result.

diagrams.title: Swift framework and the rejected alternative
diagrams.caption: Koine uses the shared resilient Swift framework. Swift types and protocols are part of its stable published contract, with library evolution and module stability enabled. Koine does not use the C-compatible alternative. Compatible provider binaries dynamically link the host-supplied framework; newer required symbols need a newer host and are checked before loading.

diagrams.title: Native schema and resolver contributions
diagrams.caption: The shared Swift framework as the loader applies it. Verify signed manifests and required framework versions before loading, then resolve the named principal class and require ProviderFactory conformance. Validate schema and authority metadata before starting the Provider. Requests/results use owned Swift values and async protocol methods. Independently built old/new binaries are verified through the native plugin seam (docs/verification/binary-compatibility.md); native trust is distinct from client capabilities.

diagrams.title: Resolve the location, then check the application hand-off limit
diagrams.caption: Implemented action-only workspace 1.0.1 contract; native registered-long/preferred-long outcomes retain their explicitly bounded VM coverage limit. This supplies no catalogue acceptance. Koine resolves the target first, then a supplied or discovered application, from search-only handles, so absence (missing or dangling, and for a target a cycle or impossible ASCII component) is established at any length and later platform nil/ENOENT/ENAMETOOLONG is never absence. Each stage applies the limit before any pathname call on its location, a discovered application's after the discovery read that found it: an extant spelling of PATH_MAX (1,024) bytes or more, not counting its NUL, is refused with failed before any request; application support for such locations is deferred past v1 (Koine#1). Registered candidates are resolved only for device/inode comparison and are never gated. Within the limit the accepted short-path metadata, handler, submission and receipt route is unchanged. First-use prompt behaviour of search-only resolution in Desktop, Documents and Downloads is an acceptance obligation; a prompt goes to Antony.

diagrams.title: Owned storage → Separate capacity, writes and overlap
diagrams.caption: Known local subterms cover two saved runs, not whole-job gross/attempt/response or opaque native peaks. K227 composes remaining source/root/bridge/final/wire terms; all selected gates and native holds bind.

diagrams.title: Selected wire → Expand selection before counting bytes
diagrams.caption: Activity/accounting view of a pure finite GraphQL design subject. Actual final scalars and errors remain unknown; conditional byte uppers are no useful fit. Core replacement occurs only after complete encoding, with no trimming or owned/native peak guarantee. Full owned composition, k215 hold, mandatory whole review and all native G/N/V remain.
